title: DHFWS Rampurhat Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 05 Staff Nurse Posts
description: District Health & Family Welfare Samiti Rampurhat (DH&FWS Rampurhat) has issued an official notification for the recruitment of 05 Staff Nurse positions. Candidates who have qualified in B.Sc. Nursing or GNM can take advantage of this opportunity and apply for the DHFWS Rampurhat Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply online ...
